mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND run_id=#{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nw_runtime_agent_run_bindings(tenant_id,run_id,input_id,session_id,target_kind,target_id,end_user_id,requester_end_user_id,actor_agent_id,role,parent_run_id,scope_snapshot,frozen_member) VALUES(#{row.tenantId},#{row.runId},#{row.inputId},#{row.sessionId},#{row.targetKind},#{row.targetId},#{row.endUserId},#{row.requesterEndUserId},#{row.actorAgentId},#{row.role},#{row.parentRunId},#{row.scope}::jsonb,#{row.frozenMember}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_chat_sessions s JOIN nw_end_users u ON u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.id=s.end_user_id AND u.status='active' WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.session_id=#{session} AND s.end_user_id=#{endUser})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_channel_agent_bindings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND channel_id=#{channel} AND agent_id=#{agent})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_service_principals WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND principal_id=#{principal} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND credential_version=#{credentialVersion} AND status='active' AND scopes @> '["sessions.write"]'::jsonb)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_service_principals WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND principal_id=#{principal} AND integration_id=#{integration} AND status='active' AND scopes @> '["groups.triggers.write"]'::jsonb)
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_group_bindings g JOIN public.nw_tenants institution ON institution.id=g.tenant_id AND institution.status IN ('active','warning') JOIN public.nw_integration_business_scopes scope ON scope.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND scope.integration_id=g.integration_id AND scope.scope_id=g.business_scope_id AND scope.status='active' WHERE g.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.id::text=#{group} AND g.integration_id=#{integration} AND g.status='active' AND (#{agent,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_group_service_agents service JOIN public.nw_agents a ON a.tenant_id=service.tenant_id AND a.id=service.agent_id AND a.status='published' WHERE service.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND service.integration_id=g.integration_id AND service.group_binding_id=g.id AND service.agent_id::text=#{agent} AND service.status='active' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_agent_deployments deployment WHERE deployment.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND deployment.agent_id=a.id AND deployment.integration_id IS NOT NULL AND deployment.integration_id<>g.integration_id))))
mapper.select: SELECT AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM public.nw_group_memberships member JOIN public.nw_end_users u ON u.tenant_id=member.tenant_id AND u.id=member.end_user_id AND u.status='active' AND u.external_integration_id=member.integration_id WHERE member.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member.integration_id=#{integration} AND member.group_binding_id::text=#{group} AND member.end_user_id=#{requester} AND member.status='active')
